item: The furniture cut counts outlets, not feed rows: the cross-source DF, its denominator and the attainable maximum
summary: compute_cross_source_df counted, per term, the source ROWS whose top-12 holds it, and the cut was a fraction of the audited rows; since a source is one feed of an outlet, the feeds of one site share its template and one publisher's furniture read as ubiquitous across unrelated sources (bbc.com alone holds 31 rows; on the shipped catalogue 46 outlets hold 257 rows, 211 extra, 4.1%). The df now counts distinct outlets (OutletMap.key), the cut and the attainable maximum use the outlet count, and the export says so (observed.cross_source_df.unit, config.furniture_unit). A unit correction: the source flag is retired and the cut is unreachable on both field corpora, so no verdict moves. The two modules join OUTLET_GATES; four tests, red without.
